content.title: Meet the Wives and Girlfriends of the 'Full Swing' Season 3 Golfers (Including One Couple Who Met at the 2012 Ryder Cup!)
content.text: Tournament wins come and go, but many of the golfers featured in Full Swing have their perfect match away from the golf course. Season 3 of the Netflix documentary series — which dropped on Feb. 25 — highlights some of the world's greatest golf stars in both their personal and professional lives. While it follows the players as they take on all four of golf's major championships — the Masters, the PGA Championship, the U.S. Open and the Open Championship — the show also shares a glimpse into some of their biggest supporters on and off the course: their romantic partners. The trailer for the season teased that while there will be plenty of competition tension surrounding the game, it will also include drama centered on their love lives. In one scene, golfers describe the moment when the news broke of Rory McIlroy's brief divorce filing from his wife Erica Stoll, followed by a confessional in which the Irish professional golfer reflects on the challenge of balancing his roles as "the best golfer, the best husband [and] the best dad." But while some episodes will be packed with intense emotions, there are also plenty of heartfelt moments shared with their partners — including Scottie Scheffler's sweet moment posing with his wife and newborn son after his victory at the Tour Championship. From a couple that met while both working at the 2012 Ryder Cup to one that has known each other since they were kids, meet the wives and girlfriends of the Full Swing season 3 golfers. Scottie Scheffler and Meredith Scudder Scottie Scheffler holds the winners trophy with his wife Meredith and son Bennett during the awards ceremony after winning the Memorial Tournament presented by Workday at Muirfield Village Golf Club on June 9, 2024, in Dublin, Ohio. Amy Lemus/NurPhoto/Getty Scottie Scheffler's wife Meredith Scudder has been by his side from the start of his professional golf journey to his rise to fame. The high school sweethearts were friends for years until sparking a romance during their senior year. During a press conference for the 2023 Sentry Tournament of Champions, Scottie joked that he "had to woo her for a few years" before they could turn their relationship romantic. After four years of dating long distance through college, the professional golfer proposed to Meredith during a hike at the Arbor Hills Nature Preserve in Texas. On Dec. 4, 2020, Scottie and Meredith wed in a church ceremony in their hometown of Dallas. In addition to cheering him on, Meredith has supported Scottie on the golf course by caddying for him at the 2022 Masters Tournament and then again during the Par 3 contest the following year. The couple welcomed their first child, son Bennett, on May 8, 2024. Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll Rory McIlroy of Northern Ireland celebrates with the trophy alongside his wife Erica and daughter Poppy after winning during the final round of the 2021 Wells Fargo Championship at Quail Hollow Club on May 9, 2021, in Charlotte, N.C. Jared C. Tilton/Getty Rory McIlroy met his wife, Erica Stoll, at the 2012 Ryder Cup, where she was a PGA transport official. She helped secure a police escort for McIlroy when he overslept and nearly missed his tee time, as he recalled to the Golf Channel in August 2019. At the time, McIlroy was in another relationship, and he and Stoll remained friends for nearly two years before quietly beginning to date in late 2014. In May 2015, he told the Times of London that they had been together for just over six months. "I am very happy in my love life. We haven't really been putting it out there," he said. "The past six or seven months have been really nice. That part of my life is going great." The pair got married on April 22, 2017, and welcomed their daughter, Poppy Kennedy, on Aug. 31, 2020. In May 2024, McIlroy filed for divorce but withdrew the filing a month later. The same day, McIlroy told The Guardian they had realized their "best future was as a family together." "Thankfully, we have resolved our differences and look forward to a new beginning," he added. Ludvig Åberg and Olivia Peet Ludvig Åberg and his girlfriend Olivia Peet with the trophy after the final round of The Genesis Invitational at Torrey Pines Golf Course on Feb. 16, 2025, in San Diego. Ben Jared/PGA TOUR/Getty Ludvig Åberg has been dating his girlfriend, Olivia Peet, since at least September 2023, when they stepped out together the week of the 2023 Ryder Cup in Rome. Since then, she has been one of his biggest cheerleaders. Following Åberg’s victory at The Genesis Invitational in February 2025, Peet shared her pride in an interview with the PGA Tour, describing the moment as a "mixture of proud [and] emotional." "He works so hard and just to see it all pay off," Peet said. Her admiration for Åberg also goes beyond his accomplishments in his career. "I'm so impressed with who he is on and off the golf course," she continued. "Honestly, he's just the best human and he's just so professional. Acts like a champ, is a champ. Yeah, he's just the best." Rickie Fowler and Allison Stokke Rickie Fowler and wife Allison Stokke pose for photos at the Spanish Steps prior to the 2023 Ryder Cup at Marco Simone Golf Club on Sept. 27, 2023, in Rome. Richard Heathcote/Getty Rickie Fowler and his wife Allison Stokke are quite the athletic duo. The professional golf player and the pole vaulter were first romantically linked in 2017 after Fowler posted a photo of the pair on Instagram. In 2018, he proposed to Stokke on the beach. She posted a photo from the engagement on Instagram, writing, "Yes!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! And happy national best friend day to my best best best friend😉! I love you!!!" The pair tied the knot on Oct. 5, 2019. One year later, Fowler shared a sweet message to Stokke on Instagram in honor of their first wedding anniversary. "A year ago today we started our next chapter ... it has definitely been a crazy year with everything going on but I’m glad we have each other," he wrote. "I wouldn’t want it any other way!" Fowler added, "I’m excited for the rest of our lives together! I love you😘." They welcomed their first child, daughter Maya Fowler, on Nov. 18, 2021. In the summer of 2024, their second daughter, Nellie, was born. Wyndham Clark and Alicia Bogdanski Wyndham Clark and Alicia Bogdanski at the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am on February 05, 2024 in Pebble Beach, California. Ezra Shaw/Getty Wyndham Clark met his girlfriend Alicia Bogdanski through mutual friends in 2021. The professional golf player and the former cheerleader kept their relationship private at first, but Bogdanski has since cheered him on through many tournaments. “If I see him overthinking something, I try to pull him back down, get him grounded and make him see things in perspective,” she told Golf Digest in September 2023. Keegan Bradley and Jillian Bradley Keegan Bradley and his wife Jillian pose for a photo at The Ring before attending the Presidents Cup Celebration prior to the 2024 Presidents Cup at The Royal Montreal Golf Club on Sept. 24, 2024, in Montreal. Chris Condon/PGA TOUR/Getty Keegan Bradley feels "so lucky" to have his wife in his corner. The American professional golfer and his wife Jillian Bradley met in 2012, got engaged in August 2015 and tied the knot in December 2016. They welcomed their first son, Logan James, on Nov. 13, 2017, followed by Cooper a few years later. Jillian has been a constant supporter of her husband's golf career, and even once served as his caddy. During season 2 of Full Swing, Keegan shared that Jillian is the "real champion" of their family. "She holds us all together," he said. Keegan also appreciates having his wife and kids with him at tournaments to cheer him on. "Best part about the FL swing is having my family with me!" he wrote on Instagram in March 2023. Joel Dahmen and Lona Dahmen Joel Dahmen poses with the trophy and his wife Lona during the final round of the Corales Puntacana Resort and Club Championship on March 28, 2021, in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. Kevin C. Cox/Getty In 2012, Joel Dahmen met his wife Lona Dahmen while in line at a pizza place in Scottsdale, Ariz., per their wedding website. At first, the American professional golfer offered to buy her a slice if she "got up the line faster than him." Lona eventually gave Joel her phone number, and the two went on a date the following week. "The rest is history," they wrote on the site. The pair wed at the Royal Palms in Phoenix, Ariz., on Dec. 15, 2018. Four years later, Joel and Lona became parents on Jan. 19, 2023, when they welcomed their son, Riggs William. Lona, who has made appearances alongside her husband in the first two seasons of Full Swing, has been a big support system for Joel throughout his career. “She’s been with me at my lowest and my highest," Joel told The Seattle Times in August 2016. "She is a big reason I am where I am, always supporting me, but also kicking my butt when I need it.” Tony Finau and Alayna Finau Tony Finau poses with the trophy and his wife Alayna and son Drace during the final round of the Cadence Bank Houston Open at Memorial Park Golf Course on Nov. 13, 2022, in Houston. Carmen Mandato/Getty Tony Finau and Alayna Finau wed on May 12, 2012, and renewed their vows 12 years later in November 2023. Tony frequently shares glimpses of his love for "best friend and wife" on social media. "She's so beautiful inside and out. My life is everything it is because I get to share it with you," he wrote on Instagram in August 2024. "Thank you for loving me and letting me love you. I love you Alayna!" The couple shares five children: Jraice, Leilene "Neenee" Aiaga, Tony, Sage and Sienna-Vee. While Tony has gained acclaim for his golf performance, he often credits Alayna for his success. After his Rocket Mortgage Classic win in 2022, he told ABC that he "couldn't have done it without my support group, and especially my wife." Adam Hadwin and Jessica Hadwin Adam Hadwin holds the trophy with his wife Jessica after winning the Valspar Championship during the final round at Innisbrook Resort Copperhead Course on March 12, 2017. Sam Greenwood/Getty Adam Hadwin married his wife, Jessica Hadwin, on March 24, 2017. The pair have one daughter, Maddox, who was born on Jan. 8, 2020. In honor of their sixth anniversary in 2023, Adam shared his appreciation for Jessica in an Instagram post, writing, "Happy anniversary to this hot mama who has put up with my crap for 6 years now." The Canadian professional golfer continued, "Maddox and I are lucky to have you with us!" After experiencing their own struggles with infertility and IVF, Adam and Jessica launched The Hadwin Family Foundation in 2020 to help others going through the same thing. “Jess is the mastermind behind everything, she has been incredible in getting everything set up," Adam told British Columbia Golf in 2021. We have done it all on our own — I should say she." Shane Lowry and Wendy Lowry Shane Lowry of Ireland poses for a photo with his wife Wendy during the Par Three Contest prior to the 2024 Masters Tournament at Augusta National Golf Club on April 10, 2024, in Augusta, Ga. Andrew Redington/Getty Shane Lowry's biggest fan is his wife, Wendy Lowry, who he married on April 12, 2016. In honor of their sixth wedding anniversary in April 2022, the Irish professional golfer penned a sweet message to Wendy on Instagram, writing, "6 years of marriage filled with ups and downs, laughters and tears and a couple of kids along the way." He continued, "I couldn’t imagine doing it with anyone else 😍🥰😘." After his Ryder Cup win in October 2023, he dedicated an "appreciation post" to Wendy on Instagram and wrote that he "wouldn't have been able to do it without her." Shane and Wendy share two daughters: Iris, who was born in 2017, and Ivy, who was born in 2021. Justin Rose and Kate Rose Justin Rose of Team Europe and wife Kate attend the Gala Dinner prior to the 2023 Ryder Cup at Marco Simone Golf Club on Sept. 27, 2023, in Rome. Ross Kinnaird/Getty Justin Rose has been with his wife, Kate Rose, for over two decades. The pair began dating in the early 2000s and tied the knot in December 2006. "Happy 11th Wedding Anniversary to the beautiful and bright Kate Rose! The force behind Team 🌹," the English professional golfer wrote on Instagram in December 2017. "15 yrs we've been together. It's been an amazing journey." In 2020, the Kate & Justin Rose Foundation co-founders launched the Rose Ladies Series, an initiative of events aimed at creating opportunities for women golfers in the United Kingdom. The pair have two children: a daughter, Lottie, and a son, Leo. Sahith Theegala and Julianna Chan Sahith Theegala and his girlfriend, Julianna "Juju" Chan, at Centre Court in July 2024. srtheegala/Instagram Sahith Theegala is grateful for the support of his girlfriend, Julianna "Juju" Chan. In May 2023, the American professional golfer dedicated an "appreciation post" to her on Instagram, writing, "Thanks for putting up with me ❤️." While Theegala is thankful for her support, Chan is just as proud to watch his success. After his September 2023 win at the Procore Championship, Chan celebrated the moment with an Instagram post, writing, "The most deserving! I love you @srtheegala." Though Theegala is the professional, Chan apparently also has some golf skills of her own. After she carried his clubs at the 2024 Masters Par 3, Theegala shared a photo of them on the golf course on Instagram, writing, "@jujurchan caddie skills 9.4/10." Justin Thomas and Jillian Thomas Justin Thomas of the United States celebrates with wife Jillian Wisniewski Thomas and the Wadley Cup after winning during the final round of the BMW Championship at Medinah Country Club No. 3 on Aug. 18, 2019, in Medinah, Ill. Sam Greenwood/Getty Justin Thomas has a "great support system" — including his wife, Jillian Thomas. The couple dated for five years before Justin popped the question in November 2021, and they tied the knot the following November. Ahead of their nuptials, Justin told PEOPLE in March 2022 that being around Jillian brings out a "better side" of him. "I mean, she truly makes me a better person," the American pro said. Justin also expressed his appreciation for her sacrifices, saying, "I'm so fortunate that she is as patient and kind of halts her life for the lifestyle that I live." Justin and Jillian became parents on Nov. 18, 2024, when they welcomed their daughter, Molly Grace. A few days later, Justin announced the news on Instagram writing, "Our little girl is here!" "Molly Grace Thomas arrived to us 11/18/24, and we couldn’t be more in love," he wrote. "Both momma (who is a superhero!) and Molly are healthy, and doing well! ❤️." Min Woo Lee and Gracie Drennan Min Woo Lee of Australia poses with the championship trophy Kirkwood Cup with girlfriend Gracie Drennan after victory on the 18th green during day four of the 2023 Australian PGA Championship at Royal Queensland Golf Club on Nov. 26, 2023, in Brisbane, Australia. Andy Cheung/Getty Min Woo Lee's girlfriend — Gracie Drennan — has been cheering the Australian pro golfer on for years. Although they haven't revealed how they met, the pair began dating in April 2019. "Happy 4 years to the best!" he wrote on Instagram in April 2023. Drennan frequently attends Lee's tournaments, cheering him on at major events such as The Open in Australia and the 2023 Masters at Augusta National Golf Club.
